conditions.bm25: Current default MaterialsStore.search(query), then prompt_data(hits); one immutable snapshot, no reranking or answer generation

metric_definitions.forbidden_free_cases: No overlap with specified forbidden ranges and no sources for forbid_all_sources questions; counts only questions with a prohibition rule
metric_definitions.empty_for_no_data_cases: No sources sent where the fixture says no source establishes the requested fact
metric_definitions.body_chars: Python Unicode character count of sent source bodies, including preserved whitespace
metric_definitions.payload_chars: Exact material payload Unicode characters; BM25 includes JSON provenance and empty-envelope overhead, whole_profile is raw profile body
metric_definitions.local_retrieval: Current search() duration only; excludes indexing, serialization, model and voice latency

path_escape.method: Direct read guard given a synthetic file outside its allowed root; no links created
